description: MVP scope argued minimal: independent capability clusters justified or deferred
rationale: Design bundles voice+mesh+multi-OS client into MVP with no split rationale; design-v1 had no scope-minimality item (PASS 5/5 missed it).

description: Named unknowns front-loaded symmetrically; no same-class unknown asserted known without validation
rationale: esp-hosted front-loaded (G-4) but custom DSI panel asserted mechanical/verified with no validating task -- risk-ordering asymmetry uncaught by design-v1.

description: No abstraction layer for <=2 unproven implementations without justification distinguishing it from rejected abstractions
rationale: protobuf rejected for low N while asr_provider_port adopted for 2 unproven impls -- internal inconsistency uncaught by design-v1.

description: Each design make-or-break validation gate is a standalone task with a pivot branch
rationale: G-4 #184/#167 retest buried as task-016 Step 4 with no pivot branch; plan-v1 had no gate-isolation item.

description: Each design-named hardware/external unknown front-loaded as an early task before code that assumes it
rationale: DSI panel/touch bring-up has no front-loaded validating task; plan-v1 had no spike-front-loading item.

description: Host suite green + firmware build green implies on-target boot (when host-sim AND on-target build both exist)
rationale: P-2 slice: all 4 batches PASS on host + idf.py build green, yet on-target flashing hit missing REQUIRES, -Werror=format-truncation aborts, and comment-*/ syntax errors that host tests structurally cannot see. Host green is necessary not sufficient.

description: Managed-component / vendored-dep patches are durable and documented
rationale: P-2 slice: the esp_hosted constructor no-op patch (port_esp_hosted_host_init.c under managed_components/) is load-bearing for no-C6 boot but is clobbered silently by rm dependencies.lock / re-fetch. No checklist item caught this fragility.

description: Test is buggy REWORK claims carry run evidence
rationale: P-2 slice: 3 sub-agents claimed test bugs — 1 hallucinated (63-char hash was actually 64, impl was correct), 1 real (unsatisfiable any_mutating_op assertion). Indistinguishable without independent verification. receiving-code-review constrains the implementer side but the checklist didn't grade whether verification happened.
